# Wi-Fi network (`wifi`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Device · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when connected to one of the Wi-Fi networks (or, with connected: false, when connected to none of them).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ssid` | text or list of text | yes |  | Network names (wildcards allowed). |
| `connected` | true / false | no | `true` | Set to false to require that you are not on any of these networks. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: wifi
    ssid: [HomeWiFi, HomeWiFi-5G]
```

## Notes

On Windows 11 24H2 and later, reading the Wi-Fi network name requires Location access for desktop apps (Settings > Privacy & security > Location). Without it this condition is always false.
